proposed_branch: Refine and explicitly submit the surviving P2_1 ordering with Sb at approximately (0.54924, 0.37235, 0.76092) and (0.13596, 0.52698, 0.63201), Te on the other two heavy-atom sites, and compare it with every surviving ordering using the same whole-profile metric.
reason: The CIFs are valid primitive P2_1 models (V = 283.948 A^3, 12 expanded atoms, Z = 2, Fe2Sb4Te4Os2, full occupancies) with no chemistry veto (minimum periodic distances 2.365-2.378 A), and indexing is strong (M(20) = 89.2 with all important observed lines covered). Exact atomic recovery is nevertheless not established: the best recorded full-profile refinement before the final CIF coordinates had residual 0.1683 versus a Le Bail/profile lower bound of 0.1113, after which the submitted coordinates were changed by integrated-intensity ordering refinements without a whole-profile score for the final instantiated CIFs. More decisively, all six Sb/Te pairings refined to nearly indistinguishable objectives (0.029695-0.030463), but only three were submitted. The absent ordering with Sb on the approximately (0.54924, 0.37235, 0.76092) and (0.13596, 0.52698, 0.63201) sites has objective 0.030027 (better than submitted alternative-2 at 0.030094), remains valid P2_1 Fe2Sb4Te4Os2, and has a 2.370 A minimum distance, so it is a concrete surviving incompatible realization.
